Michael is interested in the features of espresso machines, particularly those that offer a café-like experience at home. He is considering between simpler drip coffee makers and more advanced steam-based espresso systems. Additionally, he has a preference for sleek, modern, stainless-steel finishes.
store.1: The price range for espresso machines is between $500 and $2,000. First-time buyers can receive a discount of 10% on their purchase. store.2: Michael is interested in knowing how your shipping works, particularly if you have a local warehouse in Seattle. store.3: Michael is interested in knowing more about the specific features of the espresso machines, such as brewing frequency, cleaning complexity, and machine size.
